title: When Can Prefixes Compile LoRA? Exact Resource-Capped Tests for Frozen Attention
abstract: arXiv:2609.36766v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can a fixed continuous prefix replace a given low-rank adapter while the attention head stays frozen? In this research, we show that the answer depends on the adapter's target through three conditions. First, observability: at one causal readout, every independent key--value prefix sees the content only through the query, attention partition, and value numerator, so a target that differs on two inputs with equal summaries incurs an error floor at every prefix length; norm caps extend this floor to nearly equal summaries. Second, realizability: at a common query, any prefix reduces exactly to two aggregate variables, and the norm-capped optimum is an attained second-order-cone program, also after a fixed output projection; it places two equal-norm rank-one value updates on opposite sides of compilability. translated_title: 前缀何时能编译LoRA？针对冻结注意力的精确资源上限测试
translated_abstract: 在注意力头保持冻结的情况下，一个固定的连续前缀能否替代给定的低秩适配器？在本研究中，我们证明答案取决于适配器的目标，并通过三个条件来刻画。第一，可观测性：在单次因果读取下，每个独立的键值前缀只能通过查询、注意力划分和值分子来感知内容，因此，若目标在两个摘要相同的输入上取值不同，则在任何前缀长度下都会产生误差下界；范数约束将该下界扩展到摘要近似相同的情形。第二，可实现性：在共同查询下，任何前缀都恰好可归约为两个聚合变量，且带范数约束的最优解是一个最优值可取得的二阶锥规划问题，在经过固定输出投影后依然成立；该结果将两个范数相等的一秩值更新置于可编译性的两侧。第三，实现：在仿射查询暴露下，$2r$个带符号的槽位可以近似一个秩为$r$的值更新，但其数值以$O(（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了可观测性、可实现性与实现三个精确判据，用于判定在注意力冻结且受范数与资源约束时，固定的连续前缀能否精确编译并替代给定的低秩LoRA适配器。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes three exact criteria—observability, realizability, and implementation—to determine when a fixed continuous prefix can exactly compile (replace) a given low-rank LoRA adapter under frozen attention with norm and resource caps.
